review_scope: Source-target review of 281 keys including titles, CTA and FAQ, unit conversions, freight and shipping examples, domestic and international tracking, backpack pocket and product packaging, stock availability negation and colour/size choices.

corrections.source: How to match OOTDBuy QC photos to the variant you want
corrections.translation: Conas grianghraif iniúchta OOTDBuy a chur i gcomparáid leis an leagan atá uait

corrections.source: Keep the right evidence when an OOTDBuy spreadsheet listing changes
corrections.translation: An fhianaise is fiú a choinneáil nuair a athraíonn tairiscint i scarbhileog OOTDBuy

corrections.source: The OOTDBuy listing has a colour name but no photo. Which option should you choose?
corrections.translation: Tá ainm datha sa tairiscint ar OOTDBuy ach níl grianghraf ann. Cén rogha ba cheart duit a dhéanamh?

corrections.source: How to save a Weidian link from OOTDBuy without losing the style you chose
corrections.translation: Conas nasc Weidian ó OOTDBuy a shábháil agus taifead a choinneáil den stíl a roghnaigh tú

corrections.source: Comparing two OOTDBuy size charts when neither uses your usual measurements
corrections.translation: Conas dhá chairt méideanna ar OOTDBuy a chur i gcomparáid nuair nach n-úsáideann ceachtar acu do ghnáthmhodh tomhais

corrections.source: Reading an OOTDBuy product gallery when the photographs tell different stories
corrections.translation: Conas gailearaí táirge ar OOTDBuy a léamh nuair a léiríonn na grianghraif sonraí éagsúla

corrections.source: How to document a damaged item for an OOTDBuy after-sales request
corrections.translation: Conas damáiste d’earra a thaifeadadh le haghaidh iarratas iardhíola chuig OOTDBuy

corrections.source: What will an OOTDBuy find cost once item price and delivery are counted?
corrections.translation: Cé mhéad a chosnóidh earra a fuair tú ar OOTDBuy agus costas seachadta san áireamh?

corrections.source: How to plan packaging for a mixed OOTDBuy parcel
corrections.translation: Conas earraí éagsúla a phleanáil le haghaidh pacála in aon bheartán OOTDBuy amháin

corrections.source: How to trace the last delivery scan on an OOTDBuy parcel
corrections.translation: Conas an scanadh seachadta deireanach ar bheartán OOTDBuy a rianú

corrections.source: Trace a Weidian listing, compare size charts, read warehouse photos and follow an OOTDBuy parcel from packing through delivery.
corrections.translation: Aimsigh bunfhógra Weidian, cuir cairteacha méide i gcomparáid, scrúdaigh grianghraif ón stóras agus lean do bheartán OOTDBuy ón bpacáil go dtí an seachadadh.

corrections.source: Which link should I save from an OOTDBuy spreadsheet row?
corrections.translation: Cé na naisc ba cheart dom a shábháil ó ró i scarbhileog OOTDBuy?

corrections.source: Save the seller listing and the OOTDBuy purchase page. Note the marketplace, item number and selected option text. If the agent link later opens an empty page, the original listing gives you a way to check whether the seller still offers that option.
corrections.translation: Sábháil fógra an díoltóra agus leathanach ceannaigh OOTDBuy. Breac síos an margadh, uimhir an táirge agus téacs an rogha a rinne tú. Má osclaíonn nasc an ghníomhaire leathanach folamh níos déanaí, is féidir an bunfhógra a úsáid chun fáil amach an bhfuil an rogha sin fós ag an díoltóir.

corrections.source: Does a copied Weidian link remember my size?
corrections.translation: An gcoinneoidh nasc cóipeáilte Weidian an mhéid a roghnaigh mé?

corrections.source: Reopen the copied link and check the selected options. Keep the exact colour and size text alongside it. Some links identify a listing with several choices and reopen at its default selection.
corrections.translation: Oscail an nasc cóipeáilte arís agus féach cad atá roghnaithe. Coinnigh foclaíocht bheacht an datha agus na méide in éineacht leis. Uaireanta osclaíonn an nasc an fógra iomlán agus bíonn an rogha réamhshocraithe in ionad do rogha féin ann.

corrections.source: Which number should I use to compare two Weidian links?
corrections.translation: Cén uimhir a chuirim i gcomparáid ar dhá nasc Weidian?

corrections.source: Compare the itemID on the seller pages. Matching numbers identify the same listing on Weidian. Also compare the size, colour and package choice because multiple options can share that number.
corrections.translation: Cuir luach itemID ar an dá leathanach díoltóra i gcomparáid. Má tá siad mar an gcéanna ar Weidian, is é an fógra céanna é. Seiceáil an mhéid, an dath agus an pacáiste freisin: is féidir roinnt roghanna a bheith faoin uimhir chéanna.

corrections.source: Does a missing style photograph mean that colour is sold out?
corrections.translation: Mura bhfuil grianghraf de leagan áirithe ann, an bhfuil an dath sin díolta amach?

corrections.source: Check whether the exact colour can be selected on the live seller or agent page. A catalogue can have a name for a colour without having a picture for it. Use the live option status when deciding whether to order.
corrections.translation: Féach an féidir an dath sin a roghnú ar leathanach reatha an díoltóra nó an ghníomhaire. D’fhéadfadh ainm datha a bheith sa chatalóg gan pictiúr de. Is ar stádas reatha an rogha a bhunaítear an cinneadh ordú a dhéanamh.

corrections.source: How should I compare a flat chest measurement to my own shirt?
corrections.translation: Conas a chuirim leithead léine atá leagtha cothrom i gcomparáid le mo léine féin?

corrections.source: Lay a shirt that fits flat, without stretching it. Measure from underarm seam to underarm seam. Compare with a photo using the same endpoints and units. A chart giving chest circumference uses a different measurement.
corrections.translation: Leag léine a oireann duit cothrom gan í a shíneadh. Tomhais trasna ón uaim faoi ascaill amháin go dtí an uaim faoin ascaill eile. Cuir an tomhas i gcomparáid le grianghraf a léiríonn na pointí agus na haonaid chéanna. Tomhas eile is ea imlíne na cliabhraí ar chairt.

corrections.source: Start with the live price for your chosen option and quantity. Record the original currency, conversion rate and time of comparison. At payment, check the currency and total on the actual checkout screen.
corrections.translation: Tosaigh leis an bpraghas reatha ar an leagan agus ar an gcainníocht a roghnaigh tú. Breac síos an t-airgeadra bunaidh, an ráta malairte agus an t-am a rinne tú an chomparáid. Agus tú ag íoc, seiceáil an t-airgeadra agus an tsuim iomlán ar an scáileán íocaíochta.

corrections.source: Does the item price include international delivery?
corrections.translation: An bhfuil an seachadadh idirnáisiúnta san áireamh i bpraghas an táirge?

corrections.source: Read the item checkout and parcel quote separately. Record any seller-to-warehouse delivery charge on the purchase side. For the outbound parcel, check the destination, route, packing and services shown in the current quote.
corrections.translation: Féach ar an tsuim íocaíochta don táirge agus ar mheastachán an bheartáin ar leithligh. Cuir an costas ón díoltóir go dtí an stóras i leith an cheannaigh. Maidir leis an mbeartán amach, seiceáil an ceann scríbe, an bealach, an phacáil agus na seirbhísí atá luaite sa mheastachán reatha.

corrections.source: How do I report damage after delivery?
corrections.translation: Conas a thuairiscím damáiste tar éis an tseachadta?

corrections.source: Keep the parcel label and packaging. Photograph the outer box, internal protection, affected item and damaged area. Send the parcel reference and a description through OOTDBuy's after-sales channel and check its current reporting conditions.
corrections.translation: Coinnigh an lipéad agus an phacáistíocht. Glac grianghraif den bhosca seachtrach, den chosaint inmheánach, den táirge agus den áit a ndearnadh damáiste di. Cuir uimhir an bheartáin agus cur síos chuig seirbhís iar-díola OOTDBuy agus seiceáil na coinníollacha reatha chun an damáiste a thuairisciú.

corrections.source: Read any option or size information attached to the reference. When the size is missing, use the picture only for features it actually shows. It may establish that a jacket photographed for this listing had a zip of a particular design. It cannot tell you the chest width of the medium you are considering. Keep a short note beside the link, such as “lower zip visible, colour label unreadable, size unknown.” This preserves the value of the photograph without silently turning unknown details into expectations about your own order.
corrections.translation: Léigh sonraí na méide agus an leagain atá in éineacht leis an bpictiúr. Mura luaitear an mhéid, ní féidir ach an méid atá le feiceáil a dheimhniú. D’fhéadfadh dearadh an zip a bheith soiléir ar an seaicéad sa ghrianghraf gan leithead cliabhraigh an tseaicéid i méid M a thabhairt. Scríobh in aice leis an nasc, mar shampla: “Sleamhnán íochtair an zip le feiceáil, cód datha doléite, méid anaithnid.” Beidh a fhios agat cén sonra a chonaic tú agus cén sonra atá fós le seiceáil.

corrections.source: Imagine that your own flat width is 56 centimetres and a chart lists a chest of 112 centimetres. Those figures could describe similar widths if the chart gives a whole garment circumference. If the chart describes a body measurement instead, the comparison changes completely. Read the diagram or ask how the measurement was taken. This is an illustrative calculation. For your actual order, use the chart attached to the exact version you selected and a photograph with the tape visible if precise fit will decide whether you keep it.
corrections.translation: Abair go bhfuil do léine 56 cm trasna agus í leagtha cothrom, agus go dtugann an chairt 112 cm don chliabhrach. D’fhéadfadh siad a bheith ar aon leithead más imlíne iomlán an éadaigh atá sa chairt. Más tomhas coirp é, tá an chomparáid éagsúil. Seiceáil an léaráid nó fiafraigh cén chaoi ar tógadh an tomhas. Maidir le fíorordú, úsáid cairt an leagain a roghnaigh tú, agus iarr grianghraf den téip más é an feistiú a chinnfidh an gcoinneoidh tú é.

corrections.source: For example, suppose your saved note says “one brown bag with strap, 120 yuan.” The live page shows 95 yuan as soon as it opens, then 125 yuan after you choose the version with strap. The comparable change in this example is five yuan. The apparent saving of 25 yuan depends on a different selection. Before changing your budget, check the seller's description of what comes with the 95-yuan option. The numbers here illustrate how to make the comparison; use the values displayed for your own item.
corrections.translation: Mar shampla, tá “mála donn le strapa, 120 yuan” i do nótaí. Taispeánann an leathanach 95 yuan nuair a osclaíonn sé, agus 125 yuan tar éis duit an leagan leis an strapa a roghnú. Is é 5 yuan an t-ardú inchomparáide. Bheadh an choigilteas dealraitheach 25 yuan bunaithe ar leagan eile. Seiceáil cad atá san áireamh ar 95 yuan sula n-athraíonn tú do bhuiséad. Is samplaí iad na figiúirí seo; bain úsáid as praghsanna reatha do tháirge féin.

corrections.source: When recording the result, use wording that distinguishes supply from missing evidence. “Olive, medium selectable; no image tied to that option” is much more useful than “olive missing.” A friend reading the second note cannot tell whether the item sold out, the site failed to display a picture or the seller never photographed it. If the purchase is time-sensitive, confirm availability through the current order interface. A record you made yesterday describes yesterday's selection.
corrections.translation: Déan idirdhealú sna nótaí idir infhaighteacht agus easpa pictiúir. Is soiléire “glas olóige, méid M inroghnaithe, gan ghrianghraf ceangailte leis an leagan” ná “glas olóige ar iarraidh”. Ní insíonn an dara ceann do chara an bhfuil an táirge díolta amach, ar theip ar an íomhá luchtú nó nár ghlac an díoltóir pictiúr riamh. Má tá deifir ort, dearbhaigh an infhaighteacht ar an leathanach ordaithe. Ní bhaineann nóta inné ach leis an staid a bhí ann inné.

corrections.source: Consider this example message. “I want the olive option marked G2, size medium. The spreadsheet thumbnail is empty. Please use G2 only and contact me if this version is unavailable. The black cover picture is not my choice.” It gives the reader a selection, a size and an instruction for an exception. If the seller uses a different label, quote its wording instead of inventing your own code. Keep the screenshot with the note in case the order page later changes.
corrections.translation: Sampla de theachtaireacht: “Ba mhaith liom an leagan glas olóige leis an gcód G2, méid M. Níl aon mhionsamhail sa scarbhileog. Ordaígí G2 amháin agus déanaigí teagmháil liom mura bhfuil sé ar fáil. Níor roghnaigh mé an leagan dubh sa phríomhghrianghraf.” Sonraíonn sí an leagan, an mhéid agus an rud ba chóir a dhéanamh má tá sé as stoc. Má úsáideann an díoltóir cód eile, cóipeáil a fhoclaíocht féin. Coinnigh gabháil scáileáin leis an nóta ar eagla go n-athrófaí an leathanach.

corrections.source: If you would accept an alternative, define the limit in the same message. “Silver or grey fittings are acceptable; please ask before substituting the black bag” is a different instruction from “any similar colour is fine.” Check how the agent actually records the note and selection before paying. Save a copy of the confirmed option. The note and the selected line should agree; a note asking for olive beside a paid line for black creates avoidable uncertainty.
corrections.translation: Má ghlacfá le rogha eile, tabhair an teorainn sa teachtaireacht chéanna. Ní hionann “Glacaim le feistis airgead-daite nó liatha. Fiafraígí díom sula seolfaidh sibh an mála dubh ina ionad” agus “tá dath cosúil leis ceart go leor”. Roimh íoc, seiceáil an nóta agus an leagan atá taifeadta ag an ngníomhaire. Coinnigh cóip den rogha dheimhnithe. Má tá glas olóige sa nóta agus dubh ar an líne íocaíochta, is féidir an neamhréir sin a réiteach anois.

corrections.source: You send a friend the link to the navy sweatshirt in size large. They open it and see a white sweatshirt in small. The link may still point to the correct product. What failed to travel with it was the selection. Save a listing address and a short option record together, then test the result in a fresh tab before you rely on it for an order.
corrections.translation: Seolann tú nasc do chara chuig geansaí cochaill dúghorm i méid L. Nuair a osclaíonn do chara é, tá geansaí bán i méid S roghnaithe. B’fhéidir gurb é an táirge ceart fós é, ach nár coinníodh do rogha sa nasc. Sábháil seoladh an fhógra agus cur síos gairid ar an leagan le chéile, agus bain triail as an nasc i gcluaisín nua sula n-ordaíonn tú.

corrections.source: If the page loads and your exact option is greyed out, distinguish that case from a dead listing. Write “page available, navy B in L currently unavailable” rather than marking the entire find as broken. A second buyer looking for medium can still check that option. A buyer who needs large now knows what to ask about. The difference also matters when updating a shared spreadsheet: deleting an entire row can hide other choices that remain usable.
corrections.translation: Má osclaíonn an leathanach ach nach féidir do leagan féin a roghnú, níl an fógra iomlán as feidhm. Scríobh “tá an leathanach ar fáil, níl an leagan dúghorm B i méid L ar fáil faoi láthair”. Is féidir le ceannaitheoir a dteastaíonn M uaidh an mhéid sin a sheiceáil, agus tá a fhios ag an té a dteastaíonn L uaidh cad ba chóir a fhiafraí. Má scriosann tú an ró iomlán as scarbhileog chomhroinnte, d’fhéadfá roghanna eile atá fós ar fáil a cheilt.

corrections.source: Two jackets look equally suitable in an OOTDBuy spreadsheet. In one listing the medium has a chest of 58; in the other the large has a bust of 116. Those figures could describe nearly the same garment. They could also describe entirely different things. Before choosing between them, identify who or what was measured, which two points the tape touched and which garment needs to fit underneath.
corrections.translation: Tá dhá sheaicéad i scarbhileog OOTDBuy agus cuma oiriúnach ar an dá cheann. Sa chéad fhógra is é 58 an tomhas cliabhraigh don mhéid M, agus sa dara ceann tugtar 116 mar thomhas cliabhraigh don mhéid L. D’fhéadfadh siad cur síos a dhéanamh ar éadaí den mhéid céanna, nó ar dhá rud éagsúla. Faigh amach ar tomhaiseadh an duine nó an t-éadach, cén dá phointe a raibh an téip eatarthu agus cén t-éadach a chaithfidh luí faoin seaicéad.

corrections.source: Take a working example. Your reference jacket is 58 cm from underarm to underarm. Listing A gives a flat width of 57 cm at the same points. Listing B gives a finished garment circumference of 116 cm, explicitly measured around the chest. Roughly doubling the flat reference gives 116 cm, so B looks closer on this dimension. That does not establish identical fit. Thick material, curved seams and different armholes can make the simple doubling rule imprecise. The two chart values are now interpretable, which is the point of the exercise.
corrections.translation: Tá do sheaicéad tagartha 58 cm ó ascaill go hascaill agus é leagtha cothrom. Tugann fógra A 57 cm idir na pointí céanna. Deir fógra B go soiléir gur 116 cm imlíne an éadaigh timpeall na cliabhraí. Is ionann dhá oiread 58 cm agus 116 cm, mar sin tá B níos gaire don tomhas tagartha seo. Ní hionann sin agus feistiú comhionann: athraíonn tiús na fabraice, uaimneacha cuartha agus cruth na n-ascaillí an gaol. Is é cuspóir na comparáide ná brí an dá fhigiúr a thuiscint.

corrections.source: Imagine you record 68 cm from the high shoulder and 65 cm down the centre back. A listing showing a centre-back length of 66 cm is about one centimetre longer by the corresponding method. Comparing it with 68 cm would lead you to call it shorter. With a cropped jacket the mistaken conclusion can affect whether the hem clears your waistband. If the listing omits the starting point, ask for the method rather than guessing which convention the seller used.
corrections.translation: Samhlaigh go dtomhaiseann tú 68 cm ó bharr na gualainne agus 65 cm síos lár an droma. Má thugann an díoltóir 66 cm síos lár an droma, tá an seaicéad sin thart ar 1 cm níos faide de réir an mhodha chéanna. Dá gcuirfeá i gcomparáid le 68 cm é, cheapfá go raibh sé níos giorra. Bíonn sé sin tábhachtach i seaicéad gearr má tá a bhun le titim faoi do choim. Mura sonraítear an pointe tosaigh, fiafraigh conas a tógadh an tomhas.

corrections.source: If your measuring tape uses inches and the seller uses centimetres, convert your own reference once using 2.54 centimetres per inch. A 22.5-inch flat chest is 57.15 cm. Keeping 57.2 cm for comparison is usually more practical than repeatedly converting a chart column and rounding it to whole inches. Retain the original reading as well. It allows you to spot a transcription error if one result seems far outside the range of your other clothing.
corrections.translation: Má tá do théip in orlaí agus cairt an díoltóra ina ceintiméadair, tiontaigh do thomhas féin uair amháin: 2.54 cm in aghaidh an orlaigh. Is ionann leithead cothrom 22.5 orlach agus 57.15 cm. Bíonn 57.2 cm sách áisiúil don chomparáid. Seachain colún iomlán a thiontú anonn is anall agus a shlánú go horlaí iomlána. Coinnigh an léamh bunaidh chun earráid chóipeála a aithint má bhíonn toradh amháin an-éagsúil le do chuid éadaí eile.

corrections.source: A dimension drawing, colour chart or instructions panel can appear between photographs with little explanation. Check the labels around it. The diagram may apply to the whole family, a named model or the packaging rather than the product. In the backpack example, outside dimensions do not give the exact dimensions of an internal laptop sleeve. Padding, rounded corners and an opening narrower than the body all matter. Ask for sleeve width and usable opening if you need to carry a specific object.
corrections.translation: D’fhéadfadh líníocht toisí, cairt dathanna nó treoracha a bheith idir na grianghraif. Léigh na lipéid: b’fhéidir gur don tsraith iomlán, do mhúnla faoi leith nó don phacáistíocht atá an léaráid. Ní insíonn toisí seachtracha an mhála droma toisí beachta na hurrainne istigh don ríomhaire glúine. Tógann stuáil agus coirnéil chruinne spás, agus d’fhéadfadh an oscailt a bheith níos cúinge ná an urrann féin. Má tá gléas faoi leith le cur ann, iarr leithead inmheánach na hurrainne agus leithead úsáideach na hoscailte.

corrections.source: You do not need to annotate every image. List the contradictions that affect your requirements. For the backpack you might record three: the outside pocket appears only in the studio picture, the dark green option has no front view, and the sleeve drawing has no internal width. Beside each, identify the simplest evidence that would settle it. A front photograph of the selected bag answers two of those questions at once. A measurement of the sleeve opening addresses the third.
corrections.translation: Ní gá nóta a chur le gach íomhá. Sa mhála droma, mar shampla, ní fheictear an póca seachtrach ach sa ghrianghraf stiúideo, níl radharc tosaigh den leagan dúghlas ann agus níl leithead inmheánach urrann an ríomhaire glúine sa líníocht. Breac síos an fhianaise is simplí a réiteodh gach ceist. Freagraíonn grianghraf tosaigh den mhála a roghnaigh tú an chéad dá cheist; don tríú ceann iarr tomhas oscailt na hurrainne.

corrections.source: Send the request with the seller option text and a description of the relevant location. “Please show the front of the dark green full-size bag, then the width of its laptop sleeve opening with the tape visible” gives the reader a reproducible task. If the item is in your order, add its reference in the private OOTDBuy order channel. For available inspection services and the stage at which you can request them, consult the official Help Center and the current order interface.
corrections.translation: Luaigh ainm an leagain mar atá sé ag an díoltóir, agus abair go beacht cén áit atá le tomhas. Mar shampla: “Taispeánaigí aghaidh an mhála lánmhéide dhúghlais, agus ansin leithead oscailt urrann an ríomhaire glúine, agus na marcanna ar an téip le feiceáil.” Má tá an mála ar d’ordú cheana, cuir uimhir an táirge sa teachtaireacht phríobháideach ar OOTDBuy. Seiceáil san Ionad Cabhrach oifigiúil agus i do thaifead ordaithe cé na seiceálacha atá ar fáil agus cén tráth ar féidir iad a iarraidh.

corrections.source: When reviewing pictures of your own unit, bring back the same landmarks and the same contradiction list. Match the order option first. Then decide whether the photographs answer your essential requirements. A visible outside zip answers the pocket question; it does not establish laptop clearance. A sleeve measurement can support your size decision but does not settle whether a detachable organizer is included. Keep each conclusion with the evidence that supports it.
corrections.translation: Nuair a fhaigheann tú pictiúir de do mhála féin, féach ar na saintréithe céanna agus ar liosta na gceisteanna oscailte. Deimhnigh an leagan ordaithe ar dtús. Freagraíonn zip seachtrach atá le feiceáil an cheist faoin bpóca, ach ní thaispeánann sé an rachaidh do ríomhaire glúine isteach. Cuidíonn tomhas na hurrainne leis an méid a mheas, ach ní chruthaíonn sé go bhfuil an t-ionsáiteán inbhainte chun rudaí a eagrú sa phacáiste. Ceangail gach tátal leis an bhfianaise chuí.

corrections.source: At the end you should be able to explain the choice in plain terms. You might decide that the exact shade matters little, that a usable sleeve opening matters a great deal, and that the organizer can be purchased separately. Someone with different priorities can reasonably reach another conclusion from the same photographs. A good reading of an OOTDBuy gallery gives you that freedom. It turns a long, sometimes inconsistent collection of pictures into a short set of observations that actually changes what you do.
corrections.translation: Ag deireadh na comparáide ba cheart duit a bheith in ann do rogha a mhíniú. B’fhéidir nach miste leat an difríocht bheag sa dath, ach go gcaithfidh oscailt urrann an ríomhaire glúine a bheith sách leathan agus gur féidir an t-ionsáiteán eagraithe a cheannach ar leithligh. Seans go dtiocfaidh ceannaitheoir eile ar chonclúid eile ó na pictiúir chéanna. Ar an gcaoi seo is féidir na sonraí a chinneann an ceannach a roghnú as gailearaí fada OOTDBuy, fiú má bhíonn cuid de na híomhánna ag teacht salach ar a chéile.

corrections.source: Check the OOTDBuy Help Center promptly. Its warehouse and after-sales topics include damaged fragile items and issues found after receipt. Consult the current conditions shown for your order or parcel, particularly any reporting period or evidence requirement. Save a copy of the relevant instructions with your notes. A deadline mentioned in a forum for an unrelated shipment cannot establish how much time applies to yours. Start the inquiry while the package and its contents are still available to examine.
corrections.translation: Seiceáil Ionad Cabhrach OOTDBuy a luaithe is féidir. Tá treoracha ann faoi earraí leochaileacha a ndearnadh damáiste dóibh agus faoi fhadhbanna a thagann chun solais tar éis an tseachadta. Féach ar na coinníollacha atá i bhfeidhm ar d’ordú nó ar do bheartán féin, go háirithe an sprioc-am agus an fhianaise a theastaíonn. Sábháil cóip leis na nótaí. Ní léir ó sprioc-am a luadh ar fhóram faoi bheartán eile cé mhéad ama atá agat féin. Cuir tús leis an bhfiosrúchán fad atá an pacáiste agus a bhfuil ann ar fáil lena scrúdú.

corrections.source: If a proposed remedy involves sending something back, check the written instructions before arranging a shipment. Confirm which pieces and packaging the recipient needs, who provides the return address and what record is required for the return. A parcel label from the original shipment is not necessarily an address for after-sales returns. If the proposed remedy is an account credit or partial refund, record its amount, currency and stated effect on the case before deciding whether it resolves the problem.
corrections.translation: Má tá rud le seoladh ar ais mar chuid den réiteach, léigh na treoracha scríofa sula socraíonn tú an t-iompar. Deimhnigh cad iad na píosaí agus an phacáistíocht atá ag teastáil, cé a thabharfaidh an seoladh fillte agus cén taifead atá riachtanach. Ní gá gurb é seoladh bunaidh an bheartáin an seoladh fillte. Más creidmheas cuntais nó páirt-aisíocaíocht atá á thairiscint, breac síos an tsuim, an t-airgeadra agus an tionchar ar an gcás sula nglacann tú leis.

corrections.source: Consider an illustrative shopping list. You choose two shirts at 80 yuan each and one bag at 120 yuan. The item subtotal is 280 yuan. For now put that figure in a column labelled goods. Keep any accessory that you might add later on a separate draft line. Mixing alternatives with confirmed selections is an easy way to inflate your budget, while leaving an accessory out of a complete-set comparison can make one offer look cheaper than it really is.
corrections.translation: Sampla de liosta siopadóireachta: dhá léine ar 80 yuan an ceann agus mála amháin ar 120 yuan. Is é fo-iomlán na n-earraí ná 280 yuan. Cuir an tsuim sin sa cholún “earraí”. Fág aon ghabhálas a d’fhéadfá a chur leis níos déanaí ar líne dréachta ar leith. Má mheascann tú roghanna malartacha le ceannacháin dheimhnithe, tiocfaidh ardú saorga ar an mbuiséad. Ar an taobh eile, d’fhéadfadh tairiscint cuma rósaoire a bheith uirthi má fhágtar gabhálas as an gcomórtas idir tacair iomlána.

corrections.source: Next, inspect the live purchase summary for domestic delivery. One seller may charge for an entire order; another may display a delivery amount on each line. Check the calculation shown for the combination you chose. In the example, suppose the two shirts share an eight-yuan domestic charge and the bag has a separate six-yuan domestic charge. Your purchase-stage total becomes 294 yuan before any other applicable payment or service charges. Charging eight yuan to each shirt would overstate the total by eight.
corrections.translation: Seiceáil an seachadadh intíre sa achoimre reatha. D’fhéadfadh díoltóir amháin táille a ghearradh ar an ordú ar fad agus díoltóir eile táille a thaispeáint ar gach líne. Sa sampla, baineann táille chomhroinnte 8 yuan leis an dá léine agus táille ar leith 6 yuan leis an mála. Is é 294 yuan an t-iomlán ag céim an cheannaigh roimh aon táillí íocaíochta nó seirbhíse eile. Dá gcuirfeá 8 yuan le gach léine, bheadh an t-iomlán 8 yuan ró-ard.

corrections.source: Suppose a calculator returns an illustrative 165 yuan for one particular set of inputs. That is a planning figure for the whole proposed parcel. Do not add 165 yuan to each item. Add it once to the purchase-stage total, giving a provisional 459 yuan in this example. If a packing option later costs 12 yuan, the revised planning total is 471 yuan. These are arithmetic examples, not OOTDBuy rates. Use the options available for your contents and destination, and confirm the amount shown before payment.
corrections.translation: Abair go dtugann an t-áireamhán meastachán samplach 165 yuan do na sonraí a cuireadh isteach. Is don bheartán ar fad é. Cuir leis an iomlán ceannaigh é uair amháin, seachas 165 yuan a chur le gach earra. Sa sampla seo, is é 459 yuan an tsuim mheasta. Cosnaíonn rogha pacála 12 yuan sa bhreis, agus mar sin ardaíonn an meastachán go 471 yuan. Is samplaí áirimh iad seo, ní taraifí OOTDBuy. Seiceáil na roghanna do d’ábhar agus do cheann scríbe féin agus deimhnigh an tsuim roimh íoc.

corrections.source: In the example, an equal three-way allocation of the illustrative 165-yuan freight gives 55 yuan to each seller unit. Allocating by item value would assign each 80-yuan shirt about 47.14 yuan and the 120-yuan bag about 70.71 yuan before rounding adjustment. Those figures are bookkeeping choices. If the bag determines most of the box size, the group may prefer a separate comparison with and without the bag. Use one rule for settlement, record the rounding difference and ensure the shares add back to the actual parcel charge.
corrections.translation: Má roinntear an lastas samplach 165 yuan go cothrom idir na trí earra, is é 55 yuan sciar gach earra. Má roinntear de réir luacha, is é tuairim is 47.14 yuan sciar gach léine a chosnaíonn 80 yuan agus 70.71 yuan sciar an mhála a chosnaíonn 120 yuan, sula gceartaítear an slánú. Roghanna cuntasaíochta atá iontu. Más é an mála a shocraíonn mórchuid mhéid an bhosca, déan comparáid bhreise leis an mála agus gan é. Úsáid riail amháin leis an gcostas a roinnt, taifead an difríocht slánaithe agus cinntigh gurb ionann na scaireanna le chéile agus an costas iarbhír.

corrections.source: Examine what the original box or insert does. An insert can hold a rigid handle in position, keep two pieces apart or keep a small component from vanishing. A larger outer sleeve might mainly add empty volume. Treat them as separate decisions. “Keep the shaped insert and the accessory pouch; the outer display sleeve can be removed if permitted” is more informative than “remove boxes.” If the warehouse offers only broad choices, ask what the selected option actually removes.
corrections.translation: Féach cén fheidhm atá ag an mbosca nó ag an ionsáiteán bunaidh. Féadfaidh an t-ionsáiteán hanla righin a choinneáil ina áit, dhá chuid a scaradh nó páirt bheag a choinneáil slán. Seans nach ndéanann an clúdach maisiúil seachtrach ach toirt an bhosca a mhéadú. Déan cinneadh ar leith faoi gach cuid: “Coinnígí an t-ionsáiteán múnlaithe agus an púitse gabhálas. Féadfar an clúdach taispeána seachtrach a bhaint más ceadmhach.” Má tá roghanna ginearálta amháin ag an stóras, fiafraigh cad a bhainfear.

corrections.source: As an illustration, suppose one proposed carton measures 40 by 30 by 20 centimetres. Its outside volume is 24,000 cubic centimetres. Adding five centimetres to the height changes that to 30,000, a 25 percent increase in volume. The actual weight might change very little. The price consequence depends on the line's billing rules, rounding and applicable limits. This example explains why dimensions deserve a place in your notes; it does not give an OOTDBuy rate, divisor or guaranteed saving from removing a box.
corrections.translation: Sampla amháin is ea bosca 40 × 30 × 20 cm: is é 24,000 cm³ a thoirt sheachtrach. Má chuirtear 5 cm leis an airde, is é 30,000 cm³ an toirt nua, méadú 25%. Is beag athrú a d’fhéadfadh teacht ar an meáchan iarbhír. Braitheann aon athrú ar an gcostas ar rialacha billeála, slánú agus teorainneacha na seirbhíse. Léiríonn an sampla cén fáth ar fiú na toisí a thaifeadadh. Ní thugann sé taraif OOTDBuy, roinnteoir ná coigilteas ráthaithe má bhaintear bosca.

corrections.source: Here is a sample private order note: “Please keep the insert in the structured bag and the small accessory in its retail box. Please separate the buckle from the bag's coated front. The jacket may be folded, with the raised print kept flat if practical. If these items cannot be combined using the available service, please let me know before changing their retail packing.” Replace these details with your actual priorities. Do not include instructions that assume a particular service is free or guaranteed.
corrections.translation: Seo sampla de nóta príobháideach: “Coinnígí an t-ionsáiteán sa mhála a choinníonn a chruth, agus an gabhálas beag ina bhosca díola. Coimeádaigí an búcla amach ó aghaidh bhrataithe an mhála. Is féidir an seaicéad a fhilleadh má fhanann an cló ardaithe cothrom, nuair is praiticiúil. Mura féidir na hearraí seo a chur le chéile leis an tseirbhís atá ar fáil, cuirigí sin in iúl dom sula n-athraítear a bpacáistíocht díola.” Sonraigh do thosaíochtaí féin. Ná glac leis go bhfuil seirbhís áirithe saor in aisce ná ráthaithe.

corrections.source: When the parcel arrives, compare its label to your outbound reference. If something appears damaged, document the outer condition and internal protection as you uncover them. Keep the packaging while you consult the applicable after-sales instructions. If everything arrives as expected, write down what worked. A note such as “shaped insert preserved the bag; display sleeve was unnecessary for my use” is more transferable to your next mixed parcel than a bare freight total.
corrections.translation: Nuair a fhaigheann tú an beartán, cuir an lipéad i gcomparáid le huimhir na seolta. Má fheiceann tú damáiste, glac pictiúir den phacáistíocht sheachtrach agus den chosaint istigh agus tú á oscailt. Coinnigh an phacáistíocht fad a sheiceálann tú na treoracha iar-díola. Má tá gach rud slán, breac síos cad a d’oibrigh. Is mó an chabhair duit don chéad bheartán measctha eile nóta ar nós “chosain an t-ionsáiteán múnlaithe an mála, ní raibh an clúdach taispeána ag teastáil uaim” ná costas an lastais amháin.

corrections.source: Open your OOTDBuy records and identify the international parcel containing the missing item. Check which warehouse items you selected for that parcel. If two garments were paid for together but submitted for delivery separately, the first parcel's tracking cannot answer where the second garment is. Write down the outbound parcel reference, route as displayed, destination country and carrier tracking reference. Keep your address and full tracking number inside your private notes and the official assistance channel.
corrections.translation: Aimsigh an beartán idirnáisiúnta i do thaifid OOTDBuy ar cheart an t-earra atá ar iarraidh a bheith ann. Seiceáil na hearraí stóráis a roghnaigh tú don bheartán sin. Má d’íoc tú as dhá bhall éadaigh le chéile ach gur sheol tú ar leithligh iad, ní insíonn rianú an chéad bheartáin duit cá bhfuil an dara ceann. Breac síos uimhir an bheartáin amach, an bealach mar a thaispeántar é, an tír chinn scríbe agus uimhir rianaithe an iompróra. Ná tabhair do sheoladh ná an uimhir iomlán ach i do nótaí féin agus sa chainéal tacaíochta príobháideach.

corrections.source: When you receive the parcel, compare the label with the outbound reference and check the contents against the items assigned to it. If the parcel arrived but one garment is missing, close the delivery question and open a contents question with the relevant packaging and item evidence. If support confirms another outcome, retain the written resolution and identify precisely which parcel it covers. The result should let another reader tell which delivery was completed, which issue was investigated and whether any separate purchase is still in transit.
corrections.translation: Ag an seachadadh, cuir an lipéad i gcomparáid le huimhir an bheartáin amach agus seiceáil na hearraí i gcoinne an liosta. Má tháinig an beartán ach má tá ball éadaigh ar iarraidh, is féidir an cheist seachadta a dhúnadh agus ceist ar leith a oscailt faoina raibh sa bheartán. Cuir fianaise ar an bpacáistíocht agus ar na hearraí ar fáil. Má dhearbhaíonn an tseirbhís tacaíochta toradh eile, coinnigh an freagra scríofa agus luaigh an beartán lena mbaineann sé. Ba chóir go léireodh an taifead céard a seachadadh, cén fhadhb a scrúdaíodh agus an bhfuil ceannachán eile fós ar an mbealach.
